QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, you must return to where everything first started to regain your memories. Maybe a talk with Gaston will jog something loose.
QuestInfo.1: You shared a candid conversation with Gaston. Your adventures after awakening from the ice, bringing the crew of the Lumiere together. You realized again that they weren't just employees, but your comrades.

0.0: Some memories will remain lost forever. You should probably just try to stick to your newest adventure.
0.1: Your newest adventure began with the Lumiere. Go talk to Gaston and see what he knows.

yes.0: It's been a while since you've checked in with old Gaston. Head to the Lumiere.
